form.label: Linux auditd Relay - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Linux auditd one-record-per-line relay overview. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:syscall","linux:auditd:execve") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:user_login","linux:auditd:user_auth") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:avc" host=$host_tok$ result=denied | stats count
index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:daemon_start","linux:auditd:daemon_end","linux:auditd:daemon_config","linux:auditd:software_update") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

panel.title: Audit records over time by family

search.query: index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval audit_family=case(sourcetype="linux:auditd:syscall","syscall",sourcetype="linux:auditd:execve","execve",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_login","user_login",sourcetype="linux:auditd:path","path",sourcetype="linux:auditd:cwd","cwd",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_auth","user_auth",sourcetype="linux:auditd:config_change","config_change",sourcetype="linux:auditd:avc","avc",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_start","daemon_start",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_end","daemon_end",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_config","daemon_config",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_cmd","user_cmd",sourcetype="linux:auditd:tty","tty",sourcetype="linux:auditd:software_update","software_update",true(),sourcetype) | timechart count by audit_family

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval audit_family=case(sourcetype="linux:auditd:syscall","syscall",sourcetype="linux:auditd:execve","execve",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_login","user_login",sourcetype="linux:auditd:path","path",sourcetype="linux:auditd:cwd","cwd",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_auth","user_auth",sourcetype="linux:auditd:config_change","config_change",sourcetype="linux:auditd:avc","avc",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_start","daemon_start",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_end","daemon_end",sourcetype="linux:auditd:daemon_config","daemon_config",sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_cmd","user_cmd",sourcetype="linux:auditd:tty","tty",sourcetype="linux:auditd:software_update","software_update",true(),sourcetype) | stats count by audit_family | sort -count
index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by audit_type result | sort -count | head 20
index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval audit_user=coalesce(user, uid, auid) | stats count by audit_user | sort -count | head 20
index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_login" host=$host_tok$ src_ip=* | stats count by src_ip terminal result | sort -count | head 20

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ audit_serial=* | stats count values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(audit_type) as audit_types values(action) as actions values(result) as results values(process) as processes values(process_path) as process_paths values(file_path) as file_paths values(src_ip) as src_ips values(marker) as markers by audit_serial | sort -count audit_serial | head 50

index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:syscall","linux:auditd:execve") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_serial audit_type syscall result auid uid process process_path process_command_line audit_key marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:user_login" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host audit_serial audit_type action result auid uid user process_id process_path src_ip src terminal signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:path","linux:auditd:cwd") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_serial audit_type action cwd file_path inode file_mode file_owner_uid file_owner_gid name_type audit_key signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Authentication failure and audit configuration changes

search.query: index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:user_auth","linux:auditd:config_change") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_serial audit_type action operation result user auid uid src_ip process_path audit_key audit_rule_list marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:avc" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host audit_serial audit_type action result process process_id file_path selinux_permission selinux_source_context selinux_target_context selinux_target_class marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:daemon_start","linux:auditd:daemon_end","linux:auditd:daemon_config") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_serial audit_type action result daemon_operation daemon_state daemon_version kernel_version audit_format auid uid session_id process_id security_subject signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: User command, TTY, and software-update audit records

search.query: index=osnix sourcetype IN ("linux:auditd:user_cmd","linux:auditd:tty","linux:auditd:software_update") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_serial audit_type action result auid uid process process_id process_path user_command_cwd user_command_hex terminal tty_major tty_minor tty_data_hex software_package software_type key_enforce gpg_result root_dir marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:auditd:*" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype audit_type audit_serial action operation result auid uid user src src_ip process process_id process_path process_command_line cwd file_path audit_key audit_rule_list selinux_permission selinux_source_context selinux_target_context selinux_target_class daemon_operation daemon_state daemon_version kernel_version audit_format user_command_cwd user_command_hex tty_major tty_minor tty_data_hex software_package software_type gpg_result key_enforce root_dir signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
